name: NLST, the seeded 500-person pilot
what: 500 people of the National Lung Screening Trial in IDC v24 (TCIA doi:10.7937/tcia.hmq8-j677), drawn with a fixed seed from the data platform's NLST list; tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: 500 low-dose chest CT series, 89,363 DICOM instances, about 45.8 GB in the catalogue; these 500 are people of the full trial, which idc_nlst records, so a sum over both counts them twice
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder

segmentations.masks: the aorta, oesophagus, heart and trachea: 1,039 segmentations over 1,039 of the full trial's 203,087 CT series in IDC v24, how many of them over the pilot's 500 not counted; the IDC fetch takes the CT series alone, so they are not on the grid

the lungs and their nodules: 1,144 segmentations over 1,042 of the full trial's 203,087 CT series in IDC v24, how many of them over the pilot's 500 not counted; the IDC fetch takes the CT series alone, so they are not on the grid
segmentations.by: BAMF Health, automatic, for IDC's analysis results, 102 of them semi-automatic

segmentations.masks: 76 structures, among them every vertebra in view from C1 to L5, each named by level, the sacrum and the ribs: 126,051 segmentations over 126,051 of the full trial's 203,087 CT series in IDC v24, how many of them over the pilot's 500 not counted; the IDC fetch takes the CT series alone, so they are not on the grid
segmentations.by: IDC, automatic (TotalSegmentator 1.5.6); no radiologist has read them

segmentations.masks: tumours and nodules: 596 segmentations over 596 of the full trial's 203,087 CT series in IDC v24, how many of them over the pilot's 500 not counted; the IDC fetch takes the CT series alone, so they are not on the grid
vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh idc --collection nlst_pilot --manifest manifests/idc_nlst_pilot500.csv --batch 100, submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and, by the manifest's note, 500 series / 89,363 instances to verify.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid nlst_pilot; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="nlst_pilot",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
